content.comment_body: Hello, I am attempting to connect using [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [article_no]. I receive a popup saying 'unable to access remote device.' I have tested several IP addresses but none work. I am attaching screenshots. Does anyone have suggestions to resolve this issue? Thank you.
Can you reach the [product_name] by pinging it?

Try disabling WiFi, as Windows may prioritize communication over the network with internet access first. From your last screenshot, it appears both LAN and WiFi are active. When I connect directly using a LAN cable, I always turn off WiFi.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encounters connectivity problems while trying to access [product_name] hardware using [product_name] software, receiving an 'unable to access remote device' error. Responses focus on potential network configuration issues, especially when both LAN and WiFi are enabled, affecting the connection. The main insight points to a lack of clear troubleshooting guidance and vague error messages from the software.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to establish a straightforward connection to [product_name] hardware using the supplied software, with step-by-step instructions and descriptive error messages that assist in resolving any issues.
